title: Trajectory Test Cases
user: Engineers testing tool-calling agents in CI who need to assert critical intermediate actions and retries without unstable LLM judges or brittle whole-transcript snapshots.
smallest_useful_product: An npm library/CLI that records a scrubbed tool event sequence, matches it against a declarative partial-order state machine, injects deterministic retry faults, and produces a visual failure trace.
success_measure: A fixture suite detects 90%+ of seeded missing/extra/out-of-order tool actions while running deterministically in CI in under one minute.
constraints: Do not imply a passing trajectory proves response quality or safety
